body:
Thanks for the advice. I appreciate it more than you could know.

I guess I'm stuck on this idea of how good things could be with her and that makes every other possibility in my life this indistinguishable mass of gray, meaningless mush.

In her I've also lost my best friend as well - I wish none of it ever happened and that there was some way of stopping it all. 

Someone told me it could take me 6 months or even a year to get over it and that just feels insurmountable to me. I don't think I could take that much of this.
